review.label_source: Product owner supplied both governing-road labels with this image on 2026-09-28; assistant checked original HD image and sign crops. No second independent reviewer.

limitations: One real still, not a temporal replay. No capture cadence or cross-frame physical association has been established.
Governing-road labels are user-supplied. Road polygons and support points are approximate assistant image-space annotations, not metric geometry.
Oracle junction tests supply road association and pose deliberately; they test decision wiring, not inference quality or displayed speed-reference behavior.
The source EXIF contains a historical app 50 classification. It is provenance only: neither a 30 detection nor a validated sign box/road relation is inferred from it.
No OSM road assignment, route intention, lane count or device latency has been verified.

topology.context_provenance: Manually visible junction/road-continuity hypothesis for offline ablation, not a downloaded OSM graph or as-driven bundle. Main road curves right; branch climbs left. Local semantic IDs are not OSM way IDs.
